product_one_liner.value: Marquee unifies internal and external football data into club-specific AI insights for professional clubs' recruitment, squad planning and tactical analysis.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing navigation link was found; the site directs visitors to book a demo.

named_customers.notes: Reading FC provides a customer testimonial; the Lanús announcement describes the club using Marquee for scouting and analysis.

hq_location.notes: Headquarters as listed on the company's LinkedIn profile.

eng_blog.notes: Its News section includes two technical posts: the CTO explains model evaluation, multi-tenancy and Kubernetes deployments; the Chief Data Scientist explains Squad Fit's data methodology.

public_docs.notes: Only a public FAQ was found; navigation and footer contain no documentation, developer-portal or help-center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior AI Scientist, updated November 3, 2026, with an active application link.

model_provider.value: A football-specific LLM and 12 proprietary AI/ML models.
model_provider.notes: Marquee describes proprietary models but does not identify an external model provider or individual foundation-model names.

compliance_certs.notes: Marquee states that it completed its SOC 2 Type II audit.

last_funding.notes: The $4 million seed round was reported July 30, 2026; $6.5 million refers to cumulative funding, not this round alone.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2026 seed round falls within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job board lists one opening, Senior AI Scientist, and no SDR, BDR or account executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 14, 2026, Marquee announced access to SkillCorner Physical and Game Intelligence data across scouting reports, Discovery queries and opponent analysis.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Elad Ofer's profile lists his start as VP Product at Marquee in April 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job board and job description name no CRM or sales-and-marketing systems.
